Ayuda.AntesTexto: In Euro Truck Simulator 2, go to **Options → Gameplay** and turn off these two options:
Ayuda.AntesPausas: • **Mandatory break simulation**: the stops the game requires.
Ayuda.AntesPorque: If they are on, the game makes you sleep and stop by its own rules, which don't match the tachograph rules. With FleetManager you decide your rests following the rules below, and to pass the rest hours you can use **Skip time** on the Home page (it counts as rest).
Ayuda.Uso1: • **Insert the card** when you start working and **remove it** when you finish, just like a real tachograph. Nothing is recorded without the card.
Ayuda.Uso2: • The activity changes by itself: moving is **driving**; stopped with the engine running, after 2 minutes it switches to **other work** (so a traffic light doesn't break your driving); with the **engine off** it's **rest**.
Ayuda.Uso3: • While stopped you can choose the activity with the buttons in the Tachograph section.
Ayuda.Uso4: • Trips are recorded automatically in the History, with their route on the map.
Ayuda.Uso5: • The mini tachograph stays on top of the game so you can see your times without leaving it.
Ayuda.Uso6: • Everything is counted with the **game time**, not your clock.
Ayuda.ActOtros: **Other work:** loading, unloading, refuelling... It doesn't count as a break.
Ayuda.ActDisponibilidad: **Availability:** waiting (for example, to be loaded). It doesn't count as a break either.
Ayuda.ActDescanso: **Rest:** the only thing that counts as a break or rest.
Ayuda.Conduccion1: • **Continuously:** at most **4 h 30 min**. Then a **45 min** break. It can be split into **15 min + 30 min** (in that order), taken within those 4 h 30.
Ayuda.Conduccion2: • **Per day:** **9 h** between two daily rests. Twice a week you can go up to **10 h**.
Ayuda.Conduccion4: • **In two consecutive weeks:** **90 h** in total.
Ayuda.Diario3: • **Reduced: from 9 h to less than 11 h**. At most 3 times between two weekly rests.
Ayuda.Diario4: • It must be finished **within 24 h** of the end of the previous rest. In other words: shift (driving, breaks and work) + daily rest ≤ 24 h.
Ayuda.Semanal2: • It must start at the latest at the end of **6 periods of 24 h** since the previous weekly rest.
Ayuda.Semanal3: • In two consecutive weeks: **two regular ones**, or **one regular and one reduced**.
Ayuda.Ejemplo1: • **06:00** you insert the card and drive.
Ayuda.Ejemplo2: • **10:30** you've driven 4 h 30: you stop, turn off the engine and rest 45 min.
Ayuda.Ejemplo3: • **11:15** you drive another 4 h 30 (that makes 9 h for the day).
Ayuda.Ejemplo4: • **15:45** you remove the card and take the 11 h daily rest (for example, with Skip 11 h).
Ayuda.Ejemplo5: • **02:45** the next day you can insert the card again.
Ayuda.EjemploConsejo: Tip: watch "Next stop" on the mini tachograph and look for a service area a little before it reaches zero. FleetManager warns you 15 minutes before the mandatory stop and one hour before the daily rest.
Ayuda.FaltaVelocidad: • **Speeding:** going over the limit (with a 0.5 km/h margin) for 60 seconds. After 10 s the speed turns red and after 30 s the danger symbol appears.
Ayuda.FaltaConduccion: • **Driving time:** exceeding any of the driving limits (for example, driving on after 4 h 30 without a break).
Ayuda.FaltasNota: Offences are recorded on the trip and shown in the History.
